facts.fact: Botswana's Minister of Trade and Entrepreneurship told Parliament that the Botswana Bureau of Standards (BOBS) developed national quality standards on school uniforms, which are voluntary; the document gives no date for the body's creation and names no IT or data standard, so it is dated by its publication date.

systems.owner: Ministry of Trade and Entrepreneurship (minister answered for it)

note: The school uniform standard is a non-IT standard and the National Quality Policy is a quality policy, so neither is a published or certification fact; no certification is mentioned.
